Meaningful implementation of UNDRIP is needed
Greater Indigenous ownership and decision-making power in resource projects is needed
More equitable distribution of benefits and burdens is needed
Transparent environmental monitoring with community oversight is needed
Accelerated transition planning for affected communities and workers is needed

Even projects with significant environmental mitigation measures can still raise profound questions about environmental justice, Indigenous rights, and the equitable distribution of environmental risks
